note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Project files are the source of intent
purpose: Make each project's Markdown files the single record of what is intended, so Arcadia can read plans and decisions from any repository and you can manage the portfolio from one place.
serves: The Project goal: turn stated outcomes into routed, executable work without you holding the whole portfolio in your head.
done_when: Arcadia reads a real project's Plans, Decisions and log from its files, never edits them, and names exactly one current Action.
reading_note: The Plan's own status section says its milestone was reached and its last open Action is deferred. Its status still says active, so it looks current when it isn't. It is a candidate to close.

actions.title: Read plan and decision files
actions.why: Everything else depends on reading these files correctly and pointing at exactly where one is wrong.
actions.done_when: Managed files parse, and an invalid value names its file and field.

actions.title: Store what the files say, once
actions.why: So reading the same files twice never creates duplicate records.
actions.done_when: Syncing twice leaves one record per document.

actions.title: Add the docs sync command
actions.why: Gives you and agents one command that previews, then applies, what the files say.
actions.done_when: `docs sync` previews by default and writes only with `--apply`.

actions.title: Name the one current Action
actions.why: So 'get to work' has a single, checkable answer instead of a guess from recent commits or the backlog.
actions.done_when: `arcadia next` resolves exactly one Action, or lists blockers with their fixes.

actions.title: Try it on a second repository
actions.why: Proves the approach isn't Arcadia-specific, using Private Practice Now without changing its code.
actions.done_when: Private Practice Now was previewed and resolved, and the findings were recorded.

actions.title: Answer clarifying questions directly
actions.why: Clarifying questions were awkward to answer, so this lets you reply in Mission Control or Discord and get the next step back.
actions.done_when: A free-text reply answers the exact Decision and returns the next Action or one follow-up question.

actions.title: Read the mission log
actions.why: So each project's running narrative is part of what Arcadia knows.
actions.done_when: Each dated log entry becomes one record, with no duplicates on re-run.

actions.title: Remember which Actions wait on others
actions.why: So Arcadia never starts an Action before the Actions it depends on are finished.
actions.done_when: Dependencies survive a sync, and an Action can't be dispatched until they're met.

actions.title: Summarize long narrative documents
actions.why: Long narrative files need a short summary that is kept separate, so it is never mistaken for the source.
actions.done_when: A narrative document gets a summary Artifact that is never written back into it.
actions.note: Deferred until 'a second foreign repository, or a summary someone actually wants'. The operator's 2026-10-28 request for Plan and Action summaries is that want; see docs/design/purpose-first-plans.md.
